overview: You stood through evening prayer. The almanac names Simon and Jude. The prayer stayed the prayer. You did not stay for a second turn, and you did not bring Saturday's sermon forward into it.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Stood the prayer and did not lengthen it.

parties.name: Master Josias Thwaite
parties.context: Read the evening prayer and was not asked for more.

assets.name: the almanac
assets.disposition: Stood through evening prayer for Simon and Jude

summary: Stood through evening prayer for Simon and Jude
